people.name: Kalu Rinpoche
people.field: Tibetan Buddhist lama, meditation master, scholar and teacher

relations.subject: Kalu Rinpoche
relations.evidence: When Kalu Rinpoche was fifteen years old, he was sent to begin his higher studies at the monastery of Palpung, the foremost center of the Karma Kagyu school. He remained there for more than a decade

relations.subject: Kalu Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Kalu Rinpoche returned to Palpung to receive final teachings from Drupon Norbu Dondrup, who entrusted him with the rare transmission of the teaching of the Shangpa Kagyu.

relations.subject: Kalu Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At the order of Situ Rinpoche, he was appointed Vajra Master of the great meditation hall of Palpung Monastery

relations.subject: Reting Rinpoche
relations.evidence: During the 1940s, Kalu Rinpoche visited central Tibet with the party of Situ Rinpoche, and there he taught extensively. His disciples included the Reting Rinpoche

relations.subject: Kalu Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Returning to Kham, Kalu Rinpoche became the abbot of the meditation center associated with Palpung

relations.subject: Sixteenth Gyalwa Karmapa
relations.evidence: Returning to Kham, Kalu Rinpoche became the abbot of the meditation center associated with Palpung and the meditation teacher of the Sixteenth Gyalwa Karmapa.

relations.subject: June Campbell
relations.evidence: June Campbell, a former Kagyu nun who is a feminist scholar, acted as Kalu Rinpoche's translator for several years.
